role: LUNA-style proposal-only exploration performed by TERRA in a single-model cycle

proposals.title: Extract a live-turn coordinator
proposals.problem_or_opportunity: Worker and control queue logic lives in a large desktop UI class.
proposals.evidence: DELTA.py is 2813 lines and now owns live worker serialization.
proposals.architectural_rationale: The coordinator has a clean ownership boundary around one session turn and queued controls.
proposals.expected_behavioral_benefit: Testable nonblocking interaction and simpler control ordering.
proposals.governance_impact: Preserves serial turn and explicit approval boundaries.
proposals.validation_strategy: unit test turn/control ordering plus desktop smoke

proposals.title: Unify pending operator action envelopes
proposals.problem_or_opportunity: Promotion and model approvals have separate dictionary schemas and correlation logic.
proposals.architectural_rationale: Shared ID, target, status, authority, expiration, and correlation semantics reduce routing risk.
proposals.validation_strategy: multi-action ambiguity, cancellation, delayed approval, and restart tests

proposals.title: Add fake-manager scenarios to behavioral closure
proposals.problem_or_opportunity: The broad harness has zero model calls by design.
proposals.evidence: Full campaign model_call_count remained zero after repair.
proposals.architectural_rationale: A fake manager can exercise local-model consent, correlation, failure, and residency without uncontrolled inference.
proposals.governance_impact: No real model or provider call needed in bulk testing.
proposals.validation_strategy: campaign model-call matrix plus bounded real-model smoke

proposals.title: Clarify model registry counts
proposals.problem_or_opportunity: Registry entries include aliases and unusable specifications.
proposals.evidence: 15 entries, 10 unique specs, 5 usable specs, 5 aliases.
proposals.architectural_rationale: Self-model language should distinguish discovery from usable capacity.
proposals.expected_behavioral_benefit: More honest status and better model fallback decisions.

proposals.title: Controlled multi-hour operator pilot
proposals.problem_or_opportunity: Real long-horizon operator performance remains unproven.
proposals.evidence: Current broad pass is 199 seconds; UI smoke is compact.
proposals.architectural_rationale: This is an evidence campaign, not a new autonomy feature.
proposals.expected_behavioral_benefit: Proves resource stability, interruption behavior, noise suppression, and model residency recovery.
proposals.governance_impact: Must preserve approved-only actions and no automatic persistence.
proposals.validation_strategy: 2-4 hour operator script with checkpoints and process/GPU samples

proposals.title: Identity evidence and rollback protocol
proposals.problem_or_opportunity: Identity remains intentionally undefined and should not become decorative or authority-bearing.
proposals.evidence: Current system defers permanent naming and keeps proposals reversible.
proposals.architectural_rationale: Stable traits should be reviewed separately from purpose and permissions.
proposals.expected_behavioral_benefit: Continuity without false claims or permission drift.
proposals.governance_impact: Requires explicit review and rollback; never authorizes action.
proposals.validation_strategy: proposal stability, operator review, rollback, and purpose-separation tests
